issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents as type double, but the solution (and the likely intended implementation) uses int for these attributes. This also conflicts with the UML-declared return type int for getTotalNumberOfStudents(), creating a cross-artifact/type inconsistency that can confuse students about which numeric type to use for student counts.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the numeric types consistent. Recommended fix: update the problem statement UML to declare numberOfInscribedStudents and numberOfGuestStudents as int to match the solution and the int return type of getTotalNumberOfStudents(). Alternatively, if doubles are intended, update the solution and template to use double for those attributes and adjust getTotalNumberOfStudents() (and related methods) to consistently handle/return a double.
